requirement: The navigation sensing subsystem shall output attitude, velocity, and position estimates to the flight control system whenever the sensor suite updates, and the state estimator shall recompute the navigation solution using the latest sensor fusion filter output. 'low' navigation quality has no numeric threshold, so readers cannot agree on when the alert obligation is triggered.

requirement: Building on the hover-mode behavior defined above, the navigation state estimator shall fuse IMU, GNSS, and barometric altimeter data into a single attitude-velocity-position estimate with a probability of validity of at least 99% per hour of flight.
